techniques.name: 12-String Acoustic Strumming & Minor iv Modal Shift
techniques.description: Rhythmic 12-string or 6-string acoustic strumming with punchy snare-like accents on beats 2 and 4, transitioning smoothly from open Fmaj7 into full barre F minor

sequence: Establish slow, measured 68 BPM acoustic tempo
Strum open Fmaj7 with a gentle brush, then resolve to open Em
In the chorus, move from open C into E7, then barre F at the 1st fret
Lift the 2nd finger on fret 2 to transform F into Fm (Minor iv)
tips: Ensure the 1st fret barre is clean so the Ab note on string 3 rings clearly on Fm
Do not rush the 68 BPM tempo — the cosmic drama needs patient spacing
Let the low open E string ring out on the Em countdown measures

techniques.name: Descending Bass Voice Leading & D7/F# Transitions
techniques.description: Connecting the verse progression with stepwise bassline movement (C - B - A - G - F#) into the thumb-wrapped D7/F# chord, setting up the countdown into the zero-gravity chorus

notes: Descending bass line: C (fret 3 string 5) → B (fret 2 string 5) → Am (open string 5) → G (fret 3 string 6) → F# (fret 2 string 6)
D7/F# voicing: 2-X-0-2-1-2 (thumb wrapped over the neck on the low F# note)
Atmospheric drone: Open strings ring continuously between transitioning bass notes
sequence: Strum open C major, walking the bass note down through B to Am
Drop the bass from open A down to low G, then wrap thumb over onto the 2nd fret of string 6 for D7/F#
Hold the D7/F# tension before resolving into the dramatic countdown sequence
Ensure clean string separation on the 12-string or 6-string acoustic
tips: Wrap the fretting-hand thumb loosely over the top of the neck for the low F# note
Mute the 5th string with the underside of your thumb when fretting D7/F#
Let the open strings ring into the cosmic space between lyrical phrases

Practice the seamless lift of the 2nd finger from F to Fm

advanced.title: Complete 12-String Cosmic Performance
steps: Perform on a 12-string acoustic for authentic studio shimmer
Deliver David Bowie's theatrical, expressive vocal storytelling
Execute dynamic builds and dramatic countdown stops

commonMistakes: Playing F major instead of F minor on 'and the stars look very different' (Fm is the entire emotional hook!)
Rushing the countdown — 68 BPM is slow, theatrical, and atmospheric
Fretting the F minor barre chord weakly, muting the G string Ab note
practiceRoutine: 5 minutes: Isolated F to Fm barre chord transition drill
5 minutes: Intro Fmaj7 to Em oscillation at 68 BPM
5 minutes: Chorus liftoff progression (C → E7 → F → Fm → C)
focusAreas: Dynamic separation between intimate verses and cosmic chorus swell
metronomeWork: Practice at 55 BPM while mastering the F to Fm finger lift
Advance to target 68 BPM once transitions are fluid
Set metronome on beats 2 and 4 to develop natural acoustic sway
